algorithms.when_not_to_use: Large/continuous state spaces (discretization suffers curse of dimensionality; switch to `dqn` or `ppo`).

algorithms.name: SARSA (On-Policy TD Control)
algorithms.diff_from_parent: Replaces full-episode Monte Carlo returns with 1-step on-policy TD bootstrapping Q(s', a').
algorithms.summary_plain: Step-by-step on-policy Q-table learning that prices in exploration risk (safer near cliffs than Q-Learning).
algorithms.when_to_use: Learning TD fundamentals or small discrete environments where exploratory mistakes are very costly.
algorithms.when_not_to_use: High-dimensional continuous states or when seeking pure optimal greedy path regardless of exploration (use `q_learning` or `dqn`).

hyperparam_intuition.alpha: Learning rate controlling how fast new TD errors overwrite old Q-table estimates.
hyperparam_intuition.gamma: Discount factor balancing immediate safety vs long-term reward.
hyperparam_intuition.eps_start: Initial exploration rate decaying toward eps_end.

extension_hooks: Swap Q(s', a') for max_{a'} Q(s', a') -> `q_learning`

algorithms.diff_from_parent: Foundational tabular episodic baseline: averages complete episode returns G_t without bootstrapping.
algorithms.summary_plain: Learns action values from complete finished episodes with zero bootstrapping; ideal for learning RL fundamentals.
algorithms.when_to_use: Small discrete/discretized episodic tasks, teaching/debugging RL basics, or non-Markovian episodic benchmarks.
algorithms.when_not_to_use: Continuous control, infinite-horizon streaming tasks, or high-dimensional observations (use DQN or PPO).

algorithms.name: Double Deep Q-Network (Double DQN)
algorithms.diff_from_parent: Decouples next-action argmax selection (online net) from Q-value evaluation (target net).
algorithms.summary_plain: Fixes DQN's over-optimistic Q-value inflation with a one-line target decoupling change.
algorithms.when_to_use: Drop-in upgrade over vanilla DQN whenever discrete Q-values overshoot or fluctuate.
algorithms.when_not_to_use: Continuous action tasks (use `td3` or `sac`) or tasks needing state-value separation (`dueling_dqn`).

hyperparam_intuition.lr: Optimizer learning rate for Q-network updates.
hyperparam_intuition.target_update_freq: Target sync interval; larger values stabilize Bellman targets.
hyperparam_intuition.gamma: Discount horizon weighting future vs immediate rewards.

algorithms.name: Categorical Distributional DQN (C51)
algorithms.diff_from_parent: Learns the full categorical probability distribution over returns (51 atoms) via Cramer projection instead of a scalar Q mean.
algorithms.summary_plain: Predicts the full return distribution (risk + upside histogram) rather than just an average Q-value.
algorithms.when_to_use: Stochastic discrete environments where return variance matters or when exploring risk-sensitive control.
algorithms.when_not_to_use: Continuous control (`sac`) or when true episode returns fall far outside [v_min, v_max].

hyperparam_intuition.v_min: Lower bound of return support; must cover the worst possible discounted return.
hyperparam_intuition.v_max: Upper bound of return support; must cover the best possible discounted return.
hyperparam_intuition.n_atoms: Histogram resolution across [v_min, v_max] (51 is the canonical paper default).

extension_hooks: Compute CVaR over `probs * atoms` for risk-averse scheduling/finance
Auto-scale [v_min, v_max] or switch to Quantile Huber loss (QR-DQN)
